newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Barco replaces Cockerill in Belgian Bel-20 - papers.
newsitem.headline: Barco replaces Cockerill in Belgian Bel-20 - papers.

text.p: A Brussels bourse committee confirmed Belgian electronics stock Barco would replace steel maker Cockerill Sambre in the Bel-20 leading share index, Belgian financial papers said on Thursday.
The Bel-20 committee meets annually to reassess the make-up of the index, looking at trading volumes of the 20 component stocks over the previous 12 months.
The stock exchange had already said in October that Barco was almost certain to enter the index and would replace either Cockerill or shipper CMB.
The change comes into force on December 23, immediately after the third Friday in the month (December 20) which is the settlement date for December options and futures.
Cockerill joined the Bel-20 index at the end of 1994.
